device_entry.name: 通用Modbus从站设备
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
实验仪器通信与驱动集成
device_entry.description: 支持 Modbus RTU 或 Modbus TCP 通讯的通用现场设备，例如 PLC、远程 I/O 模块、过程控制器、传感器接口或执行器控制单元。此类设备常用于实验室自动化与测试系统中，通过线圈、离散输入和寄存器交换开关量状态、测量值、设定值以及诊断信息。
device_entry.description_en: A generic field device that communicates via Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP, such as a PLC, remote I/O module, process controller, sensor interface, or actuator control unit. In laboratory automation and test systems, such devices are commonly used to exchange digital states, measurements, setpoints, and diagnostic information through coils, discrete inputs, and registers.
